notes.title: Welcome to The Lab and Dungeons Playtest!
notes.content:
Welcome to The Lab and Dungeons Playtest! 
We appreciate your interest in The Lab and Dungeons. 
Your feedback will greatly help us in improving the game. 
For bug reports or any other feedback, please visit our Steam Community at: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2750840/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2750840/[/url]

or, our Discord server at: 
[url=https://discord.gg/ZbBNJfk6]https://discord.gg/ZbBNJfk6[/url]

Please note the following:

[list]
[*] Playtest builds contain bugs.
[*] Some contents may not be available.
[*] Updates may not always be applied to Playtest builds.
[*] We do not automatically collect play logs, so if you encounter any bugs, we would appreciate manual bug reports via the links provided above.
[*] The Playtest program is planned to conclude sometime in January 2024. After that, you will no longer be able to play.
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support!
